newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active at $71 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle fairly active at $71 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was fairly active, with slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 per cwt higher, according to USDA. Inquiry and demand was strongg.
Sales confirmed on 8,800 slaughter steers and 5,800 slaughter heifers Wednesday.
For the week to date 83,700 head confirmed including 9,700 head or about 11 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle. Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1275 lbs 71.00.
Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1025-1150 lbs 71.00.
